ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 4:1 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black/dark-gray pixels across the visible ventral surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Low-intensity (black) pixels define the continuous trailing edge boundary and distal tips. The interior surface consists of high-intensity (white) pixels interspersed with localized dark circular blobs: a cluster of approximately 8-10 spots on the left lobe and 6 distinct scattered spots on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 75 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel oscillations along the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant jagged peaks are concentrated on the inner margins of both lobes, transitioning to smaller, more uniform serrations towards the tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature fitted from the median notch to the tips. Left lobe exhibits a distinct upward-turning hook trajectory at the distal end; right lobe shows a more gradual convex tapering.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of localized dark circular pixel clusters. Significant grouping found on the lower-left lobe (proximal to trailing edge) and scattered isolated points across the right lobe medial region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, parallel, low-intensity linear marks (rake marks) detected on the right lobe, oriented diagonally from the center towards the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent parallel linear rake marks on the right lobe. Irregular notched trauma visible along the trailing edge. Heavy, bulbous dark-pigmented mass on the distal left tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Specific intersection of parallel rake marks with a single dark circular spot located between the second and third linear marks on the right lobe.
